16.en: We do not have time for… Wait! I need to examine your sidearm immediately.

32.en: was due to depart from the Macharian Sector shortly after the onset of the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.X5EFP7IgIUx6CaBW#silence-and-darkness]{Noctis Aeterna} and examine worlds along the sector’s barely explored borders. But, due to resource reallocation issues, extensive breakdowns, and tangled @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.3TtxuCzt0nNV1ysj]{Administratum} bureaucracy, the voidship is moored at a void port above @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.jB9sg2SDLZJGZrac]{Eskutchax} for the next few decades. Until then, Explorator @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.rilaQaBPslIRzGco]{Orhys-Phi-07et} is effectively stranded with idle mechadendrites and minimal resources to continue his research.

36.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.rilaQaBPslIRzGco]{Orhys-Phi-07et} believes he was built to be an Explorator, as any blessed machine is built for a specific purpose. Unlike his brothers, who appear content to wait for their ship’s departure, Orhys-Phi-07et believes he can get a head start on his Quest for Knowledge and has a hunger for travel. He is particularly interested in the Imperium’s lost technology and believes that during the Macharian Crusade, experimental weapons were fielded and never properly recovered. His ultimate goal, though farfetched, would be to discover a lost STC, thereby cementing his name in the annals of the Cult Mechanicus.

40.en: Though he keeps these feelings to himself, Orhys-Phi-07et does not believe in the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.nYfLVXh10BKR47Kj]{Adeptus Mechanicus’} philosophy of insularity from the rest of the Adeptus Terra. He thinks the Explorator Fleet could be more agile and further their knowledge if they worked more closely with other factions, members of the Inquisition chief among them. He is eager to push the boundaries of where he can operate and investigate, but he does so with extreme caution. He knows that if his fellow Tech-Priests knew what he wanted to achieve, he would lose his station on the

44.en: and be reassigned elsewhere by the Magos in charge.

48.en: He has garnered an extensive communication network across the sector for sharing information with other Explorators, Tech-Priests, and datavaults within the Mechanicus. This allows him to communicate with the characters at any significant port of call.

64.en: is ready to depart (decades from now), @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.rilaQaBPslIRzGco]{Orhys-Phi-07et} would jump at the chance to accompany the party if they were to set out to any barely explored worlds. At the very least, he is hungry for any information they can retrieve from nearby @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.nYfLVXh10BKR47Kj]{Mechanicus} facilities to aid his quest.

72.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.rilaQaBPslIRzGco]{Orhys-Phi-07et} feels that something more than bureaucratic failures is holding back the

76.en: from departing, but he lacks the authority to investigate the delays and thinks that his fellow Tech-Priests would not want him poking around. He would be incredibly grateful if the characters could investigate in his stead and share what they discover.

92.en: The Explorator can access many archives and datavaults that typical @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.nYfLVXh10BKR47Kj]{Mechanicus} agents do not — including classified analysis of xenos and heretical technology and the Explorator Fleet’s world surveys.

100.en: As an Explorator, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.rilaQaBPslIRzGco]{Orhys-Phi-07et} can recognise and analyse xenotech and archaeotech. If the characters recover a device of unknown purpose and origin, he may be able to help them discern both points. In many cases, he can demonstrate its function.
